definitions.name: F2A.ARGMAX
definitions.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
definitions.note: index of the largest number in a Vector, first one on a tie

definitions.name: F2A.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TK' BIND TK KEYS TK VALUES F2A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: key of a Record whose numeric value is largest, first key on a tie

definitions.name: F2A.ENTRIES
definitions.body: 'EN' BIND EN KEYS EN VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: Record -> Vector of [ key value ] pairs in key order

definitions.name: F2A.VMAX
definitions.body: 'VX' BIND VX VX 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: largest element of a non-empty Vector

definitions.name: F2A.VMIN
definitions.body: 'VN' BIND VN VN 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: smallest element of a non-empty Vector

definitions.name: F2A.ABS
definitions.body: 'AX' BIND AX AX -1 MUL MAX
definitions.note: absolute value, lifts over Vectors

definitions.name: F2A.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT ] MAP FLATTEN -1 DROP JOIN
definitions.note: join a non-empty Vector of Strings with single spaces

definitions.name: F2A.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'CP' BIND CP 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT CP 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN
definitions.note: String with its first character upper-cased, rest unchanged

definitions.name: F2A.TITLE
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS [ F2A.CAP ] MAP F2A.UNWORDS
definitions.note: split on spaces, capitalize each word, join with single spaces

definitions.name: F2A.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'LB' BIND LB [ 0 GET ] MAP LB [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] -> Record name to summed amount, first-appearance order

definitions.name: F2A.DEBTORS
definitions.body: F2A.BYNAME F2A.ENTRIES [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: names whose summed amount is negative, first-appearance order

definitions.name: F2A.LARGEST
definitions.body: 'LG' BIND LG LG [ 1 GET ] MAP F2A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: the [ name amount ] entry with the largest amount, first on a tie

definitions.name: F2A.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DN DD DIV 'DQ' BIND DQ DQ FLOOR EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive divisors of a positive integer, ascending

definitions.name: F2A.ISPRIME
definitions.body: F2A.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ
definitions.note: whether a positive integer is prime

definitions.name: F2A.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'PN' BIND 1 PN RANGE [ F2A.ISPRIME ] FILTER
definitions.note: primes up to and including a positive integer

definitions.name: F2A.BINARY
definitions.body: 'BN' BIND 2 20 0 RANGE POW [ BN GT NOT ] FILTER 'BP' BIND BN BP DIV FLOOR 2 G0A.MOD STR JOIN
definitions.note: positive integer (below 2^21) as a base-2 String

definitions.name: F2A.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'CZ' BIND CZ 1 COLLECT 1 200 RANGE CZ [ 'CX' BIND 'CV' BIND CV 2 DIV CV 3 MUL 1 ADD CV 2 DIV FLOOR CV 2 DIV EQ SELECT 'CN' BIND 1 CN CV 1 EQ SELECT ] SCAN CONCAT [ 1 GT ] FILTER LENGTH
definitions.note: Collatz steps to reach 1 (up to 200 steps)

definitions.name: F2A.DROOT
definitions.body: 1 SUB 9 G0A.MOD 1 ADD
definitions.note: digital root of a positive integer

definitions.name: F2A.FIBINDEX
definitions.body: 'FN' BIND 1 40 RANGE [ 0 1 ] [ 'FE' BIND 'FA' BIND FA 1 GET FA 0 GET FA 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP [ FN LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
definitions.note: smallest k with Fibonacci F(k) >= n (F(1)=F(2)=1)

definitions.name: F2A.REVENUE
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'RO' BIND RO 'qty' GET RO 'price' GET MUL ] MAP G0A.SUM
definitions.note: orders JSON -> total qty*price over priced orders

definitions.name: F2A.UNPRICED
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
definitions.note: orders JSON -> distinct skus of orders without a price

definitions.name: F2A.QTYBYSKU
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS 'OQ' BIND OQ [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OQ [ 'qty' GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: orders JSON -> Record sku to summed qty, first-appearance order

definitions.name: F2A.TAGCOUNTS
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'OT' BIND [ ] OT 'tags' GET 2 COLLECT 1 0 OT 'tags' HAS? SELECT GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
definitions.note: orders JSON -> Record tag to number of orders carrying it

definitions.name: F2A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'SS' BIND SS LENGTH 'SL' BIND SS SL 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR SL 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0A.SUM 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers

definitions.name: F2A.MAD
definitions.body: 'MDV' BIND MDV MDV F2A.MEDIAN SUB F2A.ABS F2A.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation from the median

definitions.name: F2A.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'SW' BIND SW -2 DROP SW 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD SW 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: means of every three consecutive numbers

definitions.name: F2A.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 'RX' BIND RX RX 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
definitions.note: running maximum of a non-empty Vector

definitions.name: F2A.MODE
definitions.body: SORT TALLY F2A.TOPKEY
definitions.note: most frequent number, smallest on a tie

definitions.name: F2A.TRIMMED
definitions.body: SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: mean after removing one smallest and one largest

definitions.name: F2A.RANGE
definitions.body: 'RG' BIND RG F2A.VMAX RG F2A.VMIN SUB
definitions.note: largest minus smallest of a non-empty Vector

definitions.name: F2A.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'NZ' BIND NZ NZ F2A.VMIN SUB NZ F2A.VMAX NZ F2A.VMIN SUB DIV
definitions.note: rescale each number to (x - min) / (max - min)

solutions.messy.title: LOWER F2A.TITLE
solutions.text.acronym: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
